reason: Provides browser-integrated terminal and SFTP panels for executing host or SSH commands and managing files; human review is warranted because it supports arbitrary commands, sudo, remote access, and file mutation without built-in authentication.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话中提供终端和 SFTP 面板，用于执行本机或 SSH 主机命令并浏览、上传、下载和管理文件。
summaries.en: Adds Terminal and SFTP panels to DeepSeek Harness conversations for running local or SSH-host commands and browsing, uploading, downloading, and managing files.

capabilities: Executes arbitrary commands on the local harness host
Executes commands on configured SSH targets
Uploads, downloads, creates, and deletes files through SFTP
Exposes same-origin terminal and SFTP RPC endpoints
